sections.text: Here are some handy guides that could help you get extra support

We’ve created a series of easy-read education packs to help you understand what support is available and how you can get it. There may be extra forms of support that you might not be aware of. Please note: Regulations and guidance can change over time, and these materials may not always reflect the very latest updates. For the most current, accurate, and tailored advice for your situation, we recommend contacting our service directly.
